messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning a console UI deploy tonight at 23:00 PT. Includes asset hash bump + small layout tweak. Looking for smoke cover and someone to run CDN invalidation. Plan is canary 10% -> 100% over ~15m.

jess: I can be on pager for the rollout and watch logs. Will monitor telemetry + frontend errors. Ping me if the canary spikes.

mark: Which assets are we invalidating? Full /* purge or targeted paths? Any risks for cached widgets?

sam: Targeted: /static/console/* and /index.html. We intentionally keep other long-lived assets untouched. Index.html TTL is low so should be safe. We'll only run broad invalidation if the canary is green.

elena: I'll trigger the edge-prime after invalidation. @deploy-bot — can you start the canary job at 23:00 PT and post status?

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled and will start at 23:00 PT. Build: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/3882 — initial slot: 10%. Smoke checklist: 1) login flow 2) core nav routes 3) no JS exceptions 4) quick perf p95 < 400ms. Will post health summary at each step.

jess: Quick invalidation snippet for ops: ```aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1XXXXXX --paths "/index.html" "/static/console/*"``` — run after canary passes 50% check.

mark: Rollback question: how do we pin the previous bundle quickly if needed? Which deploy tag?

sam: Rollback owner: sam + elena. Previous bundle tag is release-2027-08-01 (hash abc123). Rollback steps are in the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/frontend-rollback — TL;DR: set DEPLOY_TAG=release-2027-08-01 and trigger route swap; invalidation not required for rollback if assets already present. Abort criteria: >5% frontend error rate or major UX break.

elena: Edge prime command I'll run post-invalidation: ```curl -s https://edge-priming.redwood.io/prime?path=/index.html&concurrency=50``` — will paste results.

jess: I'll be watching APM + browser errors. If I see anything, I'll react :warning: and tag @sam.

sam: Final plan summary: start 23:00 PT; canary progression 10% for 5m -> 50% for 5m -> 100%. Run targeted invalidation after 50% pass, then edge-prime. Posting status updates in-thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
